Callie Park: Hey all  Hey! Callie here (she/her). First day on product marketing. I like bento boxes, tiny bonsai trees, and late-night code-surfing. Excited to meet folks 
Diego Ramirez: Welcome Callie!! :tada: Bento club meets on Thursdays — bring snacks or just your appetite :bento: 
Nora Chen: hi Callie, welcome!! We have a desk plant swap next week if you're into bonsai. Also pinging @onboarding-bot to confirm your laptop and door access 
onboarding-bot: Welcome Callie Park! Scheduled: buddy intro (tomorrow 11:00), equipment pickup (reception at 9:30). Temporary door access granted until first-week setup completes. 
Oliver Kim: welcome! if you ever want to do a lunchtime walk we have a small group that loops the waterfront. Also curious what your go-to bento item is? 
Callie Park: thanks all! go-to bento item is tamagoyaki + pickled veggies. Id happily trade a tiny bonsai for a cookie :wink: Ill try to make the plant swap and the Thursday bento meet 
Ava Rivera: welcome! quick logistics note: reception has a small cooler for people delivering chilled food — works great for bento sauces. Also badge is ready for pickup per reception 
Diego Ramirez: also obligatory question: tea/coffee/ramen? pick one :ramen: 
Callie Park: ramen (spicy) if forced, otherwise green tea :green_tea: 
Nora Chen: voicemail from facilitiesmdash; they left a pair of tiny pruning shears labeled "Callie" at reception. looks like someone's ahead of schedule for the bonsai swap :shears:
Callie Park: omg those are mine  I left them at the train station last week, thank you facilities hero 
Oliver Kim: welcome again! see you at the bento table :handshake:
